attchmntText: Affordable Robotic & Automation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Announcement under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Press Release".
voiceSummary: Affordable Robotic and Automation Limited Board approved Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Standalone H1 FY27 Net Revenue from Operations grew 14% year-on-year to Rs.4,907.49 Lakhs. Standalone EBITDA rose 49% to Rs.587.49 Lakhs. Standalone Profit After Tax increased 187% to Rs.166.57 Lakhs. Consolidated H1 FY27 Net Revenue from Operations grew 12% to Rs.5,236.65 Lakhs. Consolidated EBITDA rose 44% to Rs.619.51 Lakhs. Consolidated Profit After Tax increased 90% to Rs.166.95 Lakhs. The company launched Relipark parking robots and secured a Rs.19 Cr order. Humro secured a Rs.51.8 Cr order for 103 robots. FCC approval was obtained for US operations. Dealer appointments in 12 countries are scheduled for January 2027.

attchmntText: Affordable Robotic & Automation Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Affordable Robotic and Automation Limited approved its standalone and consolidated unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved a notice for postal ballot to seek shareholder approval for specific matters. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, the company reported a net profit of 166.57 lakh rupees, compared to 58.09 lakh rupees in the previous year. Basic earnings per share stood at 1.31 rupees. The company issued 10,93,750 warrants to Managing Director Milind Padole, of which 8,20,000 warrants were converted into equity shares. Trading approvals for these shares are awaited. The statutory auditors, M/s. Vijay Moondra and Co., issued a limited review report stating no material misstatements were found.

attchmntText: Affordable Robotic & Automation Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 09, 2026, titled "Pursuant to Regulation 30 and other applicable provisions of the SEBI LODR Regulations, 2015, we are hereby enclosing the Press Release issued by the Company. Kindly take the same on your records.".
voiceSummary: Affordable Robotic and Automation Limited has secured an order worth approximately Rs. 19 crore for its next-generation Automated Guided Vehicle based car parking technology. This represents the largest single order in the company's AGV car parking business since the commercial launch of the product in September 2026. The company markets these solutions under the Relipark brand. The technology utilizes battery-operated autonomous mobile robots to optimize parking space utilization. The order was announced on November 09, 2026. The company intends to offer free parking infrastructure for up to 20 qualifying projects by the end of 2027. Relipark will showcase its solutions at the Airport Parking Network London from 18 to 20 November 2026 and at ACETECH Mumbai 2026 from 19 to 22 November 2026.

attchmntText: Affordable Robotic & Automation Limited has informed the Exchange about Bagging/Receiving of orders/contracts
voiceSummary: Affordable Robotic and Automation Limited received a domestic work order to design, manufacture, supply, install, and commission an AGV Car Parking System. The order is in the ordinary course of business. The client name is undisclosed due to confidentiality. The execution period is 18 months from the commencement date. The approximate consideration is Rs. 19,00,07,000 excluding GST. The entity awarding the order has no interest from the promoter group. The transaction does not fall within related party transactions.
